lines.text: Then dairy. Then onions. Then garlic.
Her plate got smaller. The worry didn't.
Every dinner out starts with one quiet question: what's safe here?
Up to twenty in a hundred people say a food upsets them.
When foods are carefully tested again, it's closer to two or three.
Even the low FODMAP diet is built to end: a few weeks out, then foods come back, one group at a time.
The goal isn't a smaller plate. It's a surer one.
Get Regular lets you log meals and symptoms side by side, so you and your dietitian can spot possible patterns, and bring foods back.
Download Get Regular. Start with tonight's plate.
